policy.pinnacles: Birth month/day/year components are reduced with the selected explicit Pythagorean reduction policy. P1=month+day, P2=day+year, P3=P1+P2, P4=month+year.
policy.challenges: Challenge values are absolute differences and are reduced to single digits only; zero is preserved as meaningful.
policy.period_boundaries: First period runs through age 36-LifePath inclusive; second and third periods each extend the boundary by nine years; fourth begins on the following birthday and is open-ended.

remaining_before_done: Exact Flutter test SUCCESS must be visible on the tested commit.
Independent policy/reference review must remain traceable before final release.
